Convert Data to Usable Format

Source: R/classes.R
gt_data_frame.Rd

Turns the rows selected for one group-time cell into the data that an attgt_fun receives, and sets its class to include gt_data_frame. Every subset_fun should finish by calling it.

Setup functions such as setup_pte() store their internal columns under dot-prefixed names (.G, .id, .period, .Y), so they never overwrite the user's own columns. gt_data_frame() copies these to the plain names G, id, period and Y that attgt_funs use. The subset_fun must already have added name ("pre"/"post") and the local treatment indicator D.

Usage

gt_data_frame(data)

Arguments

data

rows of the full data (from a setup function) for one group-time cell, including the columns .G, .id, .period, .Y, name and D

Value

gt_data_frame object, with columns G, id, period, Y, name and D in addition to the columns of data
